purpose: Separate residual Layer-ROM propagation/closure insufficiency from four-state placement/information insufficiency after the equal-dimension placement discriminator.

authority.historical_q1_conclusion: Reduced same-partition CoRichards can be numerically unavailable; numerical unavailability is not evidence of Layer-ROM superiority.

trigger.execute_only_for: purpose/material aligned partitions listed prospectively by ROM_PURPOSE_P1_PLACEMENT_RESULT.closure_followup

representation.solver: conventional Reference-Richards discretisation on the frozen four-cell partition

fresh_workload: Reuse the exact preregistered P1 purpose/material history and boundary forcing without modification.

numerical_qualification.qualification_rule: T8, T16 and T32 must all remain in the qualified domain; the T8-T16 and T16-T32 differences on the complete frozen purpose metric vector must be finite and componentwise non-increasing toward T32. Exact fine-pair identity qualifies with zero numerical uncertainty.

decision_rules.CLOSURE_DEFICIT_SUPPORTED: Aligned Layer-ROM does not cross the frozen R512_T32 comparator; same-partition CoRichards is numerically qualified and does cross it.
decision_rules.FOUR_STATE_INFORMATION_OR_RESOLUTION_UNR: Aligned Layer-ROM and numerically qualified same-partition CoRichards both fail to cross the comparator.
decision_rules.CORICHARDS_DIAGNOSTIC_UNAVAILABLE: Same-partition CoRichards fails its frozen numerical qualification; do not infer closure sufficiency or insufficiency from that failure.
decision_rules.NO_H4_DIAGNOSTIC_REQUIRED: Aligned Layer-ROM already crosses the frozen R512_T32 comparator.
